title.en: AN ACT MAKING ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATIONS FOR SUNDRY EXPENSES OF THE GOVERNMENT OF THE CITY OF MANILA FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE THIRTIETH, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FIVE.
title.orig: AN ACT MAKING ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATIONS FOR SUNDRY EXPENSES OF THE GOVERNMENT OF THE CITY OF MANILA FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE THIRTIETH, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FIVE.

text.en:
The following sums, or so much thereof as may be respectively necessary, are hereby
appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, in part compensation for
the service of the government of the city of Manila for the fiscal year ending June thirtieth, nineteen hundred
DEPARTMENT OF ENGINEERING AND PUBLIC WORKS.
Salaries and wages, Department of Engineering and Public 'Works, city of Manila, nineteen
hundred and five:
Land transportation :
One corral foreman, at one thousand and eighty dollars per annum, two mechanics, at one
thousand and eighty dollars per annum each, eleven teamsters, Class A, one teamster, Class B,
fifteen teamsters, Class C, from April first, nineteen hundred and live; and for hire of assistant
mechanics, drivers, and laborers, as may be necessary; not to exceed eleven thousand pesos.
City repair shops:
Five mechanics, at one thousand and eighty dollars per annum each, from April first, nineteen
hundred and five; and for hire of assistant mechanics, not to exceed two thousand pesos.
Contingent expenses, Department of Engineering and Public Works, city of Manila, nineteen
hundred and five: For expenditure in accordance with the provisions of Act Numbered Twelve
hundred and sixteen, nineteen thousand pesos.
In all. for the Department of Engineering and Public Works, forty-seven thousand and ninety
pesos: Provided, That the city of Manila shall be authorized to furnish land transportation to
other branches of the Government in the city of Manila, beginning April first, nineteen hundred

and live, at actual cost, subject to regulations and tariff, which shall lie approved and
promulgated by the Governor-General.
LAW DEPARTMENT.
Contingent expenses, Law Department, city of Manila, nineteen hundred and five: For
expenditure in accordance with the provisions of Act Numbered Twelve hundred and sixteen,
including the payment of costs in criminal cases under the provisions of Act Numbered
Thirteen hundred and thirty-five, two thousand pesos.
MISCELLANEOUS.
For payment of two-thirds of reimbursement to D. H. Burnham, landscape engineer, employed
by the Secretary of War to report upon a general plan of architectural, park, and street
development for the city of Manila and elsewhere as directed by the Governor-General, in lieu
of expenses from the United States to Manila and return, one thousand three hundred and
thirty-three pesos and thirty-three centavos; and for payment of two-thirds of reimbursement to
Pierce Anderson, assistant to said Burnham, in like manner employed, in lieu of salary and
expenses from the United Slates to Manila and return, three thousand three hundred and sixty-
four pesos and twenty-three centavos; total, four thousand six hundred and ninety-seven pesos
and fifty-six centavos.
In all, for the city of Manila, fifty-three thousand seven hundred and eighty-seven pesos and
fifty-six centavos.
